verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: The cable routing is documented across five pages in sequence: (1) Page 9 — Cable Routing section shows green/yellow lines tracing from the Proposed PV Area along the rooftop parapet toward the roof edge; (2) Page 10 — continues the parapet run with routing lines, then shows the 2-inch conduit pipe exit point on the exterior wall; (3) Pages 11–12 — show the cable run descending the building exterior side wall (green/yellow/orange lines), including a narrow alley passage; (4) Page 13 — Equipment Location shows the run terminating at the 'Main Meter' panel with a 'Solar Meter & Accessories' area marked adjacent. Note: this is an Enphase IQ8P micro-inverter system, so there is no separate DCDB — each panel has its own micro-inverter outputting AC. The AC cable run from micro-inverters on the roof down to the solar meter/main panel is fully traced. No orphan ends or unexplained cable changes are observed. Conduit is present for the wall penetration (page 10).
verdicts.rationale: Cable routing is continuously documented from PV area (page 9) → parapet run → conduit wall penetration (page 10) → exterior wall descent (pages 11–12) → meter panel termination (page 13). Sequence is logical and complete with no gaps or unexplained changes. Conduit used at the wall entry point.
